LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Number.: මහ/ඉ/අත්/342.

Here by inform that the Government requires to acquire the under mentioned land and decides to acquire it for the public purpose under sub section (1) of the section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (amended) Act, No. 28 of 1964.
Description of the land that is to be acquired:

The under described plot of land with the extent and names depicted in the original Plan No. ෙකො/9517 made by the Survey General, situated at No. 524A pragathipura Grama Niladari’s Divison in Maharagama Divisional Secretary’s division in Colombo district of Western Province containing in extent of 0.0058 Hectare.
1. Lot No. 01

Name of the Land: Thambigewatta (The allotment of land Assessment No. 162/2 of Arama Road); Utilization of the land: Garden, portion of a permanent building and a well; Entitlement: National Housing Development Authority; Other detail: Dannangoda Gamage Leelawathi of No. 23/71, Arama Road, Pragathipura, Madiwela Possesses; Extent: 0.0058 Hectare.

All the people who claim the ownership or have the right or declare any other link to the above mentioned land, by themselves or their representative authorized by their document, should meet me on 29th May, 2015 at 9.00 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat of Maharagama.

Further, nature of the right and a detailed description with regard to obtain the compensation pertaining to the land acquisition, the amount of compensation and the method of its calculation should reported to me in writing with two copies, Required title deeds, their extracts, and other documents should be submitted to me to prove the proprietorship at the inquiry.
BUDDHI THARANGA KARUNASENA, Divisional Secretary, Maharagama. Divisional Secretariat, Maharagama. 29th April, 2015. 05 - 427
